senses.zh_definition: 卡尔：人名，通常用作男性名字；此处为缺乏语境时的暂定识别。
senses.en_definition: Carl: a personal name, conventionally masculine.
senses.ms_definition: Carl ialah nama khas orang, lazimnya nama lelaki.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 在此指专有名词。姓名通常不意译；下列是自然姓名组合，不是可验证的高频词汇搭配。[德国德语协会：Karl/Carl](https://gfds.de/vorname-der-woche-karl-carl/)

etymology.historical_story: Carl belongs to the Germanic naming tradition and is associated with Karl and Charles. Its deeper origin is debated: the familiar explanation connects it with a word for man, while the German Language Society discusses an alternative connection with an army-related name element. Neither explanation supplies the everyday meaning of a person's name. [德国德语协会：Karl/Carl 的来源](https://gfds.de/vorname-der-woche-karl-carl/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Carl 记作“卡尔”这位具体的人：看到它先识别人名，不把 car 或结尾 l 拆成词根词缀。
